releaseNotes.headline: A lighter, steadier rail
releaseNotes.summary: Fixes memory growth from hover details and quota reset scheduling, reduces idle animation and Claude cache work, and cleans up the rail’s corners.

highlights.title: Lightweight hover details
highlights.detail: Hover details reuse one card, preventing the memory growth caused by repeatedly opening and closing the previous popover.

highlights.title: Steady quota resets
highlights.detail: Quota resets use the existing refresh tick so cancelled reset timers no longer accumulate in the background.

highlights.title: Less idle work
highlights.detail: Status and critical-limit animations update at a bounded rate, and Claude cache entries are opened only once per read.

highlights.title: Cleaner rail corners
highlights.detail: Removes the rail shadow that could leave square pockets around its rounded corners.
